mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invitations (email, name, role, department_id, status, invited_by, expires_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{name}, #{role}, #{departmentId}, #{status}, #{invitedBy}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM invitations WHERE email = #{email} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE invitations SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE invitations SET status = 'ACCEPTED', accepted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
